RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  April 26, 2010/V aisakha 6, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Reduction  in grants-in-aid to NGOs
*421. SHRI RANJITSINH
VIJAYSINH MOHITE-PATIL:  Will the
Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  his Ministry has decided
to reduce grants-in-aid  in the next financial
year for the Non-Governmental
Organisations (NGOs) working under new
and renewable energy sources;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the budgetary allocations made for
this purpose under the grants-in-aid to
NGOs during 2007-08, 2008-09 and
2009-10; and
(d) the details of grants already
sanctioned to various NGOs and the
Utilisation Certificates submitted by them
during those years?
Forest cover
*422.  SHRI KISHORE KUMAR
MOHANTY: W ill the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the area in hectares and in percentage
terms, which  is under forest cover in the
country, State-wise;
(b) the national average of forest cover
in hectares and percentage;
(c) whether Government proposes to
launch a new initiative to expand forest
cover in the country ;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken to compensate Orissa;
(e) the scheme-wise details of the funds
provided by Government to the States
including Orissa for conservation,
development and promotion of forests
during  the last three years and the current
year, State-wise and year-wise; and
(f) the achievements made, as a result
thereof?
129

130
Regional imbalance in power sector
†*423.  SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the vast
variance in country's energy resources is
due to regional variance in terms of natural
resources, thereby leading to some regions
having adequate power while others hardly
having  any power;
(b) if so, whether any coordinating
agency is working at  national level to
remove this variance; and
(c) if not,  whether  setting up of any
such coordinating agency is being
considered?
Environmental clearance to irrigation,
road and infrastructure projects
†*424.  SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN :
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that a large
number of proposals, including proposals
relating to irrigation, road and
infrastructural development, are pending
before  Government for environmental
clearance under the Forest (Conservation)
Act, 1980;
(b) if so, the details thereof as on date
and the reasons therefor, State-wise;
(c) whether Government  plans to
simplify the process relating to the
environmental clearance to various projects;
(d) if so, the details thereof;  and
(e) the extent to which the simplification
of the environmental  clearance process
would be helpful in according clearance to
the pending projects?
Malnutrition in Orissa
*425.  SHRIMATI RENUBALA
PRADHAN: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any study to identify the level of
malnutrition among children in rural and
urban areas in Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof;  and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Modification in environmental
regulations
*426.  SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Gujarat has
1600 Km long coastline and some
modification in the State's environmental
regulations is required;
(b) whether any proposal to modify the
State's environmental regulations is being
considered by the Central Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof;  and
(d) if not, the  reasons therefor?
Employment in FIIs
*427.  SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI :
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  the food processing industry
is employment intensive and for investment
of  every Rs. 1 crore it creates 18 jobs directly
and  64 indirectly in the organized sector
and 20 jobs in the unorganized sector across
the supply chain;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

131
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the future action plan prepared so
far?
Power  crisis in Karnataka
*428.  SHRI ANIL H. LAD: Will the
Minister of POWER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  the increased demand of
power in the neighbouring  States of Andhra
Pradesh and Tamil Nadu has aggravated the
on-going power crisis in Karnataka;
(b) whether heavy overdrawal from
the Central power grid by Tamil Nadu and
Andhra Pradesh has left little for Karnataka,
which is now facing a shortage of 1000MW;
(c) whether the share from  V arahi hydel
power station to the State grid has dropped
drastically; and
(d) if so, what is the Central
Government's initiative to bail out
Karnataka from its present power crisis?
Tiger reserves
†*429.  SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of reserves in the country
that are enlisted at present for the protection
of tigers;
(b) whether the number of tigers has
risen or fallen in these reserves during  the
last two  or three countings and if their
number  has come down, the reasons
therefor; and
(c) whether Government proposes to
establish some more reserves or to take
further concrete steps to protect this
species  that is becoming extinct?
Pollution in Ganga
†*430.  SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  the sewage
water  discharged from the cities situated
along the Ganga river is the main cause for
its pollution;
(b) if so, the  percentage  of pollution
estimated  to be caused to Ganga water  as
a result thereof;
(c) whether any assessment  has been
made to address this problem; and
(d) if so, the  amount that  would be
required to tackle this problem on the basis
of the said  assessment?
Review of MPLAD Scheme
*431.  SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has  conducted
any performance review of MPLAD
Scheme through NABARD Consultancy
Services;
(b) if so, the details  and outcome
thereof; and
(c) the follow-up action being taken by
Government on the basis of the outcome?
National Mission for Enhanced
Energy Efficiency
*432.  SHRI RAJIV PRA TAP RUDY:
Will the Minister of POWER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has envisaged
to improve energy efficiency of designated

132
consumers under the National Mission for
Enhanced Energy Efficiency;
(b) if so, the details of the energy
efficiency targets, sector-wise,  time-frame
of its implementation  Five Year Plan-wise
and the monitoring mechanism thereof; and
(c) if not, by when Government intends
to fix such time-bound targets and
implement the monitoring mechanism?
Receding of Himalayan glaciers
*433.  SHRI T.K. RANGARAJAN:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether competent agencies have
conducted comprehensive studies and
research on the receding of glaciers in the
Himalayan range;
(b) if so, the details of such  agencies;
(c) whether it is a fact that the glaciers
are  receding in this area;
(d) if so, whether an assessment of the
adverse effect of this phenomenon on the
Indian sub-continent has been made; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
precautionary measures proposed or taken
by Government in this regard?
Implementation of RGGVY
*434.  SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether  the Bharat Nirman
programme, launched by Government in
2005, includes provisions for connecting
all the rural households under the Rajiv
Gandhi Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana
(RGGVY) within five years;
(b) if so, the salient objectives thereof
indicating the  status  of implementation,
State-wise, at the conclusion of five years
of its launching,  showing the cost budgeted
vis-a-vis incurred actually, year-wise;
(c) whether   the Comptroller and
Auditor General of India (CAG) has
reviewed the implementation of  the
programme during any of these years; and
(d) if so, the observations made, if any,
by CAG about its implementation,
utilization of allocated funds, etc.?
Claims on forest land
*435.  SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the break-up of tribal and non-tribal
claimants for forest land;
(b) whether Government is aware about
the high level rejections of claims for forest
land;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the area of land for which pattas had
been distributed?
Climate research centres
*436.  SHRI N. K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  India and United States
have recently agreed to set up climate
research centres to find out technological
solutions for low carbon growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any technologies, to  meet
the emission intensity reduction target of
20 to 25  per cent by 2020, have been
offered by US; and
(d) if so, the details thereof  and to what
extent the setting up of climate research
centres is beneficial for India?

133
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 20th April, 2010 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 30, 1932 (Saka)
Setting  up of Gram Nyayalayas
*437.  PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  Government's ambitious
plan to open mobile rural courts (Gram
Nyayalayas) across the country has not been
found  feasible by a majority of the States;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether, in view of mounting
pending cases in courts, Government would
again convince the State Governments/UTs
to set up mobile rural courts  to dispose  of
cases expeditiously; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Generation of solar energy
*438.  SHRIMATI  KANIMOZHI:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has started
work towards  the stated goal of generating
10,000 MW of electricity through solar
energy by 2020 and if so, the details thereof;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) how Government  proposes to
provide  incentives to public and private
organizations to invest  in renewable
sources of energy; and
(d) the details of the steps taken by
Government to establish a 'Single Window
Clearance' as mentioned in the Jawaharlal
Nehru National Solar Mission?
Judicial  interference in Advocates'
Body
*439.  DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there  has been judicial
interference in Advocates'  Body;
(b) if so, what are the segments strongly
protesting such interference and the nature
of protests made by Advocates' Body in
this regard; and
(c) the measures taken/proposed to be
taken to mitigate or nullify  such
interference?
Effect of hydro power projects on
Bhagirathi river
†*440.  SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that efforts are
afoot to start a hydroelectric project and to
launch 53 new projects on Bhagirathi river
in Uttarakhand;
(b) if so, whether  these projects would
force the national river Ganga to the brink
of extinction, directly affecting 30 per cent
of the country's population;
(c) if so, the action being taken by
Government for conservation of Ganga
river; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)

440,

Power : 423, 428, 432, 434,

Implementation : 431,
Tribal Affairs : 435,
